facts.fact: The consolidated National Registration Act (Chapter 01:02, Act 26 of 1986) is an Act of Parliament that commenced on 31 December 1986 and was amended up to Act 11 of 2017 and S.I. 124 of 2017; it provides for the Registrar of National Registration to keep a national register of citizens aged 16 or over and for identity cards to be issued.

systems.system: National register and district registers of citizens (identity cards)
systems.owner: Department of Civil and National Registration

note: Consolidated text is paywalled after section 5; it states nothing on biometrics or on rules made under the Act, so no cover fact.
